description: Given a list of integers a with at least two elements that contains at least one even and at least one odd number, return the first even element minus the first odd element, where 'first' means closest to the start of the list. A number is even when its remainder modulo 2 is 0 and odd otherwise; negative numbers are classified the same way (for example -3 is odd and -4 is even).
notes: VERINA states the postcondition as: there exist indices i, j such that a[i] is even, a[j] is odd, every element before i is odd, every element before j is even, and result = a[i] - a[j]. Both specs state the equivalent result == FirstEven(a) - FirstOdd(a) with small recursive helpers, because Dafny cannot find the index witnesses for the concrete probes.
